full_judgment: 10. The impugned judgment and decree dated 19.11.2009 passed by the learned Judge, Small Causes Court and Senior Assistant Judge, Pabna Sadar, Pabna, in S.C.C. Suit No. 4 of 2000 dismissing the suit is hereby set aside and accordingly the said S.C.C. suit is decreed. The plaintiffs-petitioners do get khas possession in the suit premises after evicting the defendant-opposite party therefrom.
